subject: german
topicDisplay: Theme 2 Popular Culture Free Time Activities; Customs Festivals And Celebrations; Celebrity Culture
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.explain: 'Lust haben' means 'to fancy/feel like' doing something, e.g. 'Hast du Lust ins Kino zu gehen?'.
'Die Beziehung' means 'the relationship'.

questions.q: How do you say 'You should drink enough water'?
questions.explain: 'Genug' = 'enough' and 'trinken' = 'to drink'; 'wenig' (little) is the trap.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We celebrate Christmas with the family'?
options: Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie
Wir vermeiden Weihnachten mit der Familie
questions.explain: 'Feiern' = 'to celebrate' and 'mit der Familie' = 'with the family', so this is correct.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Turn left at the traffic lights'?
options: Biegen Sie an der Ampel rechts ab
Biegen Sie an der Ampel links ab
Gehen Sie an der Ampel geradeaus
Biegen Sie an der Ecke links ab
questions.explain: 'Links abbiegen' = 'turn left' and 'die Ampel' = 'the traffic lights'.
'Älter' means 'older', so 'mein älterer Bruder' = 'my older brother'. 'Jünger' would be younger.
'Der Schlaf' means 'sleep'; 'schlafen' = 'to sleep'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Ich verbringe zu viel Geld online
Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online
questions.explain: 'Zeit verbringen' = 'to spend time' and 'zu viel' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich bekomme ein Geschenk' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'bekommen' means 'to get/receive', not 'to become'. 'To become' is 'werden'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I go swimming twice a week'?
options: Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche tanzen
Ich gehe einmal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Monat schwimmen
questions.explain: 'Zweimal pro Woche' = 'twice a week' and 'schwimmen' = 'to swim'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I do sport to keep fit'?
options: Er treibt Sport, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, weil ich fit bin
Ich treibe Sport, um dick zu werden
Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu bleiben
questions.explain: 'Sport treiben' = 'to do sport' and 'um... fit zu bleiben' = 'in order to keep fit'; 'ich treibe' is the correct form.
'Die Spritze' means 'an injection/jab'.
'Die Wohnung' means 'the flat/apartment'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I get on well with my sister'?
options: Ich ärgere mich über meine Schwester
Ich streite mich mit meiner Schwester
Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Schwester
questions.explain: 'Sich gut verstehen mit' means 'to get on well with', so this is 'I get on well with my sister'.

questions.q: How do you say 'Smoking is harmful to health'?
options: Rauchen ist schädlich für die Gesundheit
Rauchen ist gut für die Gesundheit
questions.explain: 'Schädlich' = 'harmful' and 'für die Gesundheit' = 'for health', so this is correct.
'Die Reise' means 'the journey/trip'; 'der Reis' (rice) is the near-miss.
'Die Metzgerei' (also 'Fleischerei') means 'the butcher's shop'.
'Der Schwager' means 'the brother-in-law'; 'der Schwiegervater' is the father-in-law.

questions.q: How do you say 'We spent the holidays by the sea'?
options: Wir verbringen die Ferien am Meer
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht
Wir haben die Ferien am Meer gebraucht
Wir haben die Ferien in den Bergen verbracht
questions.explain: 'Am Meer' = 'by the sea' and 'verbracht' (perfect of 'verbringen') = 'spent'; 'gebraucht' (needed) is the trap.
'Die Gesundheit' means 'health'; from 'gesund' = healthy.
False friend: 'sensibel' means 'sensitive'. 'Sensible' (English) would be 'vernünftig'.
'Das Rauchen' means 'smoking' (the activity). 'Der Raum' (room) is a near-miss distractor.
